query: I’ve been really excited lately because my local community garden just started a weekly farmers’ market, I picked up the juiciest heirloom tomatoes there last Saturday and they tasted way better than any I’ve bought at the grocery store before. I also signed up for a beginner pottery class that starts next week, I’ve always wanted to learn how to make my own mugs and small bowls for my kitchen. Oh, and my cat just figured out how to open the cabinet where I keep her treats, so I’ve had to move them to a higher shelf to stop her from sneaking extra snacks all day. Anyway, I’m having some issues with my mobile service right now — I’ve noticed my network connection is really slow and keeps cutting out, I have data saver mode turned on already, and I just got a notification that I’ve exceeded my monthly data limit, can you help me figure out how to fix this?
